evidence: Static source port and manual source review only; no builds, syntax checks, tests, project/game execution, GPU/API calls, process inspection or Bedrock operations

sourcePort.integration: depth_tracker marks destination metadata pending before forwarding the real call and publishes the copied arguments after that original call returns
sourcePort.identity: Per-object private scalar tokens on actual public device/resource arguments; global monotonic token/revision counter; recycled interface addresses are not persistent identities
sourcePort.ownership: Metadata stores copied scalar descriptors and identity tokens only, without GPU object references or raw COM pointers
sourcePort.views: Single-array Texture2D and Texture2DMS; explicit format/mip/RTV plane/DSV flags retained; restricted typed null-descriptor defaults; unsupported or null resource arguments leave the overwritten handle unknown
sourcePort.copyRules: Snapshot every source before invalidating destinations; exact nonzero handle counts; bound 256; reject overlapping source/destination or duplicate destination handles; unknown sources remain unknown
sourcePort.publication: Destination revision and copied source revisions must survive the real driver call; pending or superseded writes cannot publish old known mappings; capacity invalidation and counter exhaustion fail closed; writes while observation is disabled clear old mappings before returning
sourcePort.bindingJoin: The actual OMSetRenderTargets list supplies its device; descriptor kind/handle/device token, resource token and resource description must match the scoped native attachment's real transition resource
sourcePort.scope: Attachments retain up to nine role snapshots inside the original native framebuffer call; a complete single color/depth pair may transfer to the bounded native list binding shadow; exact role/handle counts and descriptor revisions are rechecked on consumption
sourcePort.rechecks: Descriptor snapshots must retain their exact revision/value, with the full descriptor cohort rechecked under one metadata lock; existing framebuffer/texture/resource guards are also retained
sourcePort.unknownOperations: Malformed legacy barrier arrays, aliasing barriers and enhanced barriers invalidate the current framebuffer resource cohort; partial, split and post-bind transitions were already rejected
sourcePort.output: Scalar format/mip/plane/sample/dimension/DSV flag facts and per-role/aggregate argument-correlation status; no addresses and no rendering authorization

limitations: The original view creation APIs return void; observed argument metadata does not establish driver validation or valid physical descriptor contents
Array, 3D, buffer and unsupported default-format views remain unknown
Only attachment resources already witnessed by actual transitions in the same native framebuffer call can join; unchanged-state, deferred-first-use and default swapchain resources remain unresolved
Late attachment can miss prior view creation; the source does not fabricate metadata for unseen descriptors
Read-only DSV flags are preserved as supplied facts, without promoting them to known queued depth/stencil states
Descriptor correlation does not establish exclusive target ownership, safe native insertion or asset retirement on the native queue
Actual world/shader/feature-group joins, installed-game native rendering and full parity remain unfinished
